events.label: JD Vance NBC News interview on 2028 and 2026 midterms

slots.name: presidential contest year
slots.sentence: In an interview with MS NOW, Cruz said Vance does not have the 2028 GOP nomination locked down and that he wants to “certainly be part of the discussion.”

slots.name: reelection year
slots.sentence: A spokesperson for Cruz, who is not up for reelection until 2030, told NBC News that the Texas senator is focused on helping Republicans in this year’s midterm election and will continue campaigning for GOP candidates over the coming weeks.

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: Vance, 42, has said consistently that his focus is on his job as vice president and on helping his party through the midterms — and that any decision about running to succeed Trump in 2028 won’t come until after then.
